facts.statement: Narambuenatitan is a lithostrotian titanosaur sauropod found in late Cretaceous deposits of northern Patagonia, Argentina.
facts.quote: Narambuenatitan is a genus of lithostrotian titanosaur sauropod from late Cretaceous (lower-middle Campanian stage) deposits of northern Patagonia of Argentina.

facts.statement: Fossils of Narambuenatitan were collected between 2005 and 2006 from the Anacleto Formation in northern Patagonia.
facts.quote: It was collected in 2005 and 2006 from the Anacleto Formation (Neuquén Group) in northern Patagonia.

facts.statement: The genus Narambuenatitan was first named by Leonardo S. Filippi, Rodolfo A. García, and Alberto C. Garrido in 2011.
facts.quote: It was first named by Leonardo S. Filippi, Rodolfo A. García and Alberto C. Garrido in 2011

facts.statement: The generic name Narambuenatitan refers to the location Puesto Narambuena.
facts.quote: The generic name refers to Puesto Narambuena.

facts.statement: The specific name palomoi honors the discoverer Salvador Palomo.
facts.quote: The specific name honours the discoverer, Salvador Palomo.

facts.statement: Narambuenatitan is classified within the clade Lithostrotia, forming a trichotomy with Epachthosaurus and the clade Eutitanosauria.
facts.quote: Narmabuenatitan was assigned to the clade Lithostrotia in a trichotomy with Epachthosaurus and the more derived clade Eutitanosauria.

facts.statement: Narambuenatitan belongs to the family Saltasauridae.
Narambuenatitan lived during the late Cretaceous, approximately 83.5 to 75 million years ago, in what is now South America.
facts.quote: que vivió a finales del período Cretácico, hace aproximadamente 83,5 a 75 millones de años durante el Campaniense de lo que es hoy Sudamérica.

facts.statement: The time range for Narambuenatitan is estimated from 83.6 to 72.2 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Campanian to Campanian (83.6 to 72.2 million years ago)

facts.statement: Narambuenatitan is known from the incomplete holotype skeleton MAU-Pv-N-425.
facts.quote: Narambuenatitan is known from the holotype MAU-Pv-N-425, an incomplete skeleton.
